items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-02
items.q: You don't know whether that client plays Benny Goodman or Peanuts or Gold.

ctx.x: Been to Japan. Oh, that's so great. And I mean, like we say, we don't know who's imitating who. Because everywhere you go, somebody has a little idea of something you did. Or you look at them, something they're doing. And I got jazz records from the Japanese musicians. You don't know whether that client plays Benny Goodman or Peanuts or Gold.
What years were they making jazz in Japan? When did they start? The same years we've been doing. They've had jazz all along.
